We need answer JSON only. Need solve plan. Need analyze task.

User asks: create formula for column E in Excel that displays 'Revenue' if corresponding cell in B6:B13 contains word 'deposit', and 'Expenses' if contains 'withdrawal'. Answer ranges E6:E13. Workbook has B values Deposit/Withdrawal capitalized. Need formula likely =IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("deposit",B6)),"Revenue",IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("withdrawal",B6)),"Expenses","")) or maybe exact? "contains the word" suggests SEARCH case-insensitive. Need fill formula E6:E13. Existing E6-E9 have values Revenue/Expenses/Revenue, E10-E13 null. We need set formulas for all E6:E13. Use fill_formula with top-left formula =IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("deposit",B6)),"Revenue",IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("withdrawal",B6)),"Expenses","")). This will produce for B10 Withdrawal -> Expenses, B11 Withdrawal -> Expenses, B12 Withdrawal -> Expenses, B13 Deposit -> Revenue. Existing E6-E9 match. Need preserve formatting? fill_formula likely sets formula only, not style? It may preserve? Operation doesn't include style. Fine.

Need ensure formula strings begin =. Use English. SEARCH classic. Could use =IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("deposit",B6)),"Revenue",IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("withdrawal",B6)),"Expenses","")) . If no match returns blank. Could also use =IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("deposit",B6)),"Revenue",IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("withdrawal",B6)),"Expenses",B6)) but blank better.

Need output JSON object only. route operations, summary, operations array one fill_formula. Ensure no markdown.
</think>

{
  "route": "operations",
  "summary": "Fill E6:E13 with a formula that returns Revenue when B contains deposit and Expenses when B contains withdrawal.",
  "operations": [
    {
      "op": "fill_formula",
      "sheet": "Sheet1",
      "range": "E6:E13",
      "formula": "=IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH(\"deposit\",B6)),\"Revenue\",IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH(\"withdrawal\",B6)),\"Expenses\",\"\"))"
    }
  ]
}
